assets.name: bix
assets.house_style: Clean, friendly cartoon illustration for a grade 3 to 5 classroom tool: smooth soft outlines in dark plum, gentle cel shading, soft light from the upper left, simple rounded shapes, cheerful and warm, not babyish. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no border, no frame.
assets.prompt: A small, cute, round cartoon mascot shaped like a soft bumpy brain: one rounded blob body that is also its head, about as wide as it is tall, with a few gentle curved fold lines on the top half. The body is a very pale, almost white, warm off-white color with soft light lavender-grey shading (it gets tinted to other colors later, so keep it pale and evenly lit, with no pink or colored patches on the body). Big friendly dark plum eyes with a small white shine, a simple dark plum mouth, no nose, no ears, no hair. Two short stubby legs and two thin arms in dark plum (#4b3a6b), with small round mitten hands in the same pale off-white as the body, and two small rounded feet in light grey. Seen straight on from the front, standing on one ground line, the whole figure in frame. Nothing worn: no headband, no shoes, no bag, no medal, no clothes. Pose and face: standing relaxed, both arms hanging loosely at the sides with the hands a little away from the body, big happy open smile, eyes open and bright. Happy and friendly.
assets.local_note: Bix happy (idle): Gym map, Locker, room default; also the arms-down frame of the jumping jacks. Tinted per color swatch in code (multiply filter). Record anchors after the pick: feet center, headband line (left and right edge points at forehead height), body top, chest point for the medal, near shoulder for the bag strap, both hand centers, and the body height (for matching scale across paintings).
